text:
Ana: Quick sync for Sundial private deploy — last blockers before cutover. Short list: peering + subnet ranges, KMS key usage policy, CloudTrail -> SIEM path. Can we resolve today?
Mike: I can take networking. Do we have the final VPC CIDR and allowed egress ranges?
Ana: VPC CIDR is 10.40.0.0/16, they want restricted egress to 10.0.0.0/8 and a managed NAT for updates. Also need to allow Redwood Dedicated egress IPs (I pasted them in the onboarding doc).
Jess: Got it. One ask — customer wants a single-handed route to our peering gateway rather than prefix lists. That's fine but needs firewall ACLs on their side. Any CIDR overlap checks?
Mike: No overlap. Ran a quick script: `python3 scripts/check_overlap.py --vpc 10.40.0.0/16 --peer 10.50.0.0/16` returned clean. I'll push the peering config after Sam signs off on the IAM/KMS bits.
Sam: KMS questions: do they want a customer-managed key (CMK) in their account or a cross-account key we manage? Their security team prefers CMK in their account with key policy granting Redwood encryption/decrypt role.
Ana: Correct — CMK in their account. We need the exact key ARN and the intended key usage (encrypt only for ingress logs, decrypt for model artifacts staging?). They asked for a minimal policy.
Sam: Minimal key policy we propose: grant Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey permissions to `arn:aws:iam::REDFOX_ROLE` and CloudTrail principal for log encryption. Example snippet:```{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/reedwood-deploy"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]}
  ]
}```Replace ACCOUNT_ID with customer acct. Need their Security PM to paste actual ARN.
Jess: For audit logs: CloudTrail to their central S3 bucket + CloudWatch Logs subscription to their SIEM. We need the bucket path and the retention policy. Are we receiving logs into our monitoring or do they ingest on their side?
Ana: They will forward to their SIEM. But we need read-only access to the CloudTrail bucket for debugging during onboarding window (48h). Suggest a short-lived bucket policy with our `redwood-onboard@redwood-infra` role.
Mike: Network note: for NAT, we've requested they place a firewall rule: allow outbound to our control plane IPs on 443 and 5222. Example IAC snippet I will apply after they confirm:```terraform
resource "aws_route_table" "peer_rt" {
  vpc_id = "vpc-abc123"
  route {
    cidr_block = "10.50.0.0/16"
    gateway_id = "pcx-0a1b2c"
  }
}
```I'll watch for the peering acceptance.
Sam: Also flag: KMS key rotation window. They want annual rotation; our tooling expects auto-rotate enabled. Confirm they are ok with rotation = enabled. If not, we'll set up a rotation alert.
Ana: Customer replied: "Annual rotation OK, but key alias must start with `sundial/` and CloudTrail encryption must use the same key." I'll paste their message into the ticket.
Jess: For SIEM ingestion we need subscription filter: provide the `logGroup` name and the `filterPattern`. They said app logs go to `/aws/usage/sundial-app` and CloudTrail is `/aws/cloudtrail/sundial`.
Mike: Great — schedule-wise, can we do the cutover Friday 18:00 UTC? That gives us Monday business window for rollback if any issues.
Sam: I can approve KMS policy now if Ana gives me the final ARN.
Ana: ARN posted in the onboarding doc: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321012:key/abcd-ef12-3456`. Sam, please attach the minimal policy and I'll request their IAM team to add our role.
DeployBot: deploy-checker completed: network: OK, kms: pending, cloudtrail-bucket-access: pending. See https://deploys.redwood.ai/checks/3067890123
Mike: I'll hold on terraform apply until DeployBot shows kms: OK.
Jess: Minor nit: they use a third-party SIEM that requires TLS inspection — customer confirmed it's allowed on their egress firewall.
Ana: Action items: Mike -> apply peering and NAT rules; Jess -> confirm subscription filter + SIEM endpoint; Sam -> attach minimal key policy and confirm rotation; Ana -> request short-lived bucket access and coordinate cutover time with customer. We'll reconvene 1h before cutover in #ops-bridge.
Sam: Approved the key policy, left a comment in the doc about least-privilege role ARN.
Ana: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update the ticket and ping ops-bridge before cutover.
Jess: I'll also add a quick runbook snippet for audit support during the 48h window.
Mike: Ready on my side once peering acceptance completes.
Ana: Closing this thread — final sync in 1h before cutover.
